description: Use when handling incoming data in a Dotkernel project — writing or changing an InputFilter, an Input class, or a laminas-form Form; wiring validators, filters and error messages; handling CSRF on a templated project; validating uploads; or deciding where a value should be checked. Also use when a write endpoint accepts data it should reject, when validation messages are inconsistent, or when a form redisplays without its errors.
